text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Superior Sulcus Tumor) with Right Pancoast Syndrome.

The progressive weakness, sensory loss, weight loss, and smoking history in a 55-year-old male strongly suggest a lung apex mass compressing the brachial plexus. I need to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray and MRI_Spine_C8_T1.
